svg.aria-label: Left: an IP packet with destination and source addresses. Right: an NDN Interest carrying only a name for the content wanted
svg.text: IP: a letter to an address
NDN: a request for a thing
The network only reads the address.
What’s inside is the two ends’ business:
every copy comes from that one machine.
(no address at all, on either side)
The network reads the name. Any router
or cache holding that Data may answer:
the Data carries its own signature.

figure.figcaption: The internet was designed for conversations between machines. Most of what it carries now is people asking for things.
